items.title: Anthropic to seek $1.4 trillion valuation in blockbuster IPO
items.brief: Anthropic’s debut on public markets will be unlike any that’s come before it, in ways that amount to either a once-in-a-generation opportunity — or a massive financial gamble, depending on whom you ask.

items.title: Paul McCartney achieves billionaire status, becomes world’s third-richest musician
items.brief: Paul McCartney reached the realm of billionaire status Monday after Forbes valued his net worth at a colossal $1.4 billion – making him the world’s third-richest musician.

items.title: US inflation rose more than expected last month
items.brief: The cost of everyday necessities continued to climb in October, putting more pressure on Americans already struggling to keep up with grocery bills, housing costs and other household expenses.

items.title: First snow, coldest air in months headed for eastern US in wake of storm
items.brief: Winter will make its first cameo in the eastern United States later this week as a storm ushers in the coldest temperatures in six months for tens of millions of people and the first snow for some.

items.title: US evacuates aircraft from British military base after threat from Iran, WSJ reports
items.brief: The United States has evacuated American military aircraft from a military base in England on Monday following a threat from Iran, according to The Wall Street Journal , which cited sources familiar with the matter.
